title: Prepare the 1.1.1 Android feature-parity preview
changes: Set the maintained Android preview version to 1.1.1 with version code 26 and prepare release notes covering the initial parity work and remaining limitations.
validation: Android Docker build and 29 Kotlin tests passed in release-111-android-38o2tleu. APK manifest and SHA-256 were verified, and the signing certificate matches the previous local and published previews.

Cached Linux and Windows Docker exports were matched against their successful test gates and validated in release-111-desktop-npuz9nuc. Archive manifests, executable headers, private-file exclusions and the staged Android source digest passed in release-111-package-validation-owiiffg3.
All eight release payload and notes checksums match SHA256SUMS.txt in the staged publication directory.
limitations: Android real-game state transfer, undo and backup restore remain unverified on a phone. Android remains a debug-signed preview with incomplete desktop feature parity. Windows test gates use Wine.
